title.zh: 胡塞10/24-25對沙烏地發動本輪衝突最大規模多點攻勢——利雅德、達曼、納季蘭三座機場加一座空軍基地、延布與拉比格油源同時被點名，10/22報告的『機場重開只是時間差』判斷這次要改判成『重開本身的前提就不成立』；Mandiant/GTIG與BeyondTrust揭露中國關聯ARMORY CASTLE(原UNC5221)用零時差打穿BeyondTrust Remote Support、潛伏近七週；PHP2Shell曝險站台估計達224萬台，CrowdStrike執行長公開示警入侵潮將至
title.en: Houthis launch this conflict's largest multi-site wave yet against Saudi Arabia on 10/24-25 — three airports (Riyadh, Dammam, Najran), an air base, and the Yanbu and Rabigh oil sites all named at once, forcing a revision of the 10/22 report's 'reopening is just a timing lag' call into 'the reopening's underlying premise never held'; Mandiant/GTIG and BeyondTrust disclose China-nexus ARMORY CASTLE (formerly UNC5221) breaching BeyondTrust Remote Support via a zero-day and dwelling nearly seven weeks; PHP2Shell's exposed-host estimate reaches 2.24 million as CrowdStrike's CEO publicly warns of a coming breach wave

focus.zh: 本期涵蓋10/24-10/26。地緣/軍事端：胡塞武裝10/24-25發動本輪衝突以來規模最大的一次多點攻勢，聲稱同時瞄準利雅德國王哈立德國際機場、達曼國王法赫德國際機場、納季蘭機場、海米斯穆塞特空軍基地，以及延布阿美石油設施、拉比格煉油廠、東西輸油管，葉門亞丁的沙烏地支持政府另指控胡塞對亞丁海巡總部發射3枚彈道飛彈。沙烏地聯軍僅證實在延布與塔伊夫方向攔截2枚彈道飛彈，對利雅德、達曼等多處『命中』的說法未正面證實；沙方同時指控胡塞瞄準麥加與麥地那，胡塞則單獨否認這項指控——雙方說法在規模與目標上都對不上，必須明講這是資訊戰的一部分，不是已核實的戰損清單。這輪攻勢，胡塞自稱是對沙方前24小時內近百次空襲的回擊，使衝突進一步脫離10/14報告記錄的『川普劃線在伊朗本土、對葉門內部衝突收手』框架——這次交火雙方都在沙國與葉門本土，不涉及伊朗，但升級幅度已超過10/18報告建立的『19死364傷、3座機場』基準線，新增至少第4座機場與1座空軍基地，顯示該基準線從未是衝突的天花板，只是當時的一個快照。10/22報告的方法論判斷是『機場宣布重開不代表風險解除，該追蹤航空公司實際排班，兩者之間永遠有落差』；這次的新進展把這個判斷往前推了一步——利雅德機場原訂10/26(今日)恢復航班，但胡塞發言人在攻勢後明確表示機場『仍是軍事目標』，意味著先前的落差不只是行政/保險評估的滯後，而是因為支撐『重開』這個宣告的安全前提本身從未真正成立。美國國務院已於10/21(攻勢前3天)下令非緊急人員與眷屬撤離沙烏地阿拉伯(發言人Tommy Pigott明確表示僅限沙國、非全波灣)，事後回看，這個撤離令時點相當精準。布蘭特原油10/20已衝上111.05美元、創五個月新高，本次升級的後續定價尚未查到可靠數據，但方向上應會疊加既有的地緣風險溢酬。烏克蘭戰線：俄羅斯對能源基礎設施的攻勢沒有降溫，10/25澤倫斯基通報熱電廠與變電站再度遭夜間打擊，造成4死28傷；烏克蘭官方彙整過去一週數據為約1,600枚滑翔炸彈、48枚飛彈、近2,300架攻擊無人機，首次把這條戰線的消耗烈度量化到週級數字，可作為後續比較的基準，也再次印證10/18報告『美國期中選舉前的政治日曆收斂，不會讓俄羅斯的戰場烈度同步降溫』這個判斷持續成立。資安端：BeyondTrust與Mandiant/GTIG於10/15聯合揭露CVE-2026-102764——這個CVSS 4.0達9.3分的BeyondTrust Remote Support零時差，被中國關聯間諜集群ARMORY CASTLE(原以未歸類編號UNC5221追蹤，CrowdStrike另稱WARP PANDA)自8/29起利用，直到9/28才被BeyondTrust自己發現，潛伏期近七週；這起事件本站先前未收錄，這次回補是因為它與本站長期追蹤的邊界設備/遠端存取供應鏈風險主題直接相關，且攻擊者刻意刪除系統與應用程式日誌的手法值得記錄。另外，PHP2Shell(CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619)的曝險規模這次有了更精確的估計：CybelAngel清點全球224萬台公開曝險的PHP主機，其中59%跑在已不再提供修補的版本線上；CrowdStrike執行長George Kurtz 10/23公開示警這會引發一波入侵潮，但截至目前查核，仍未看到任何一起被證實的大規模淪陷案例，必須把『曝險規模』與『已發生的入侵』分開看待。本期nexus把胡塞這波攻勢與10/19週報、10/20報告建立的『攔截彈分配隊伍：美軍優先、波灣次之、台灣第三』判斷放在一起讀——沙烏地自己的攔截彈庫存本來就因長期消耗而向法、英、巴基斯坦、埃及求援(且已遭英、巴、土耳其部分回絕)，這次高強度多點攻勢等於是對這個本已吃緊的隊伍再加一次實彈壓力測試，而洛馬自己揭露的產能擴充時間表要到2030年底才到得了2,000枚年產能——三個分屬不同領域的事實(即時戰場消耗、產業產能曲線、地緣分配順位)這次有了同一個可以互相校驗的時間點。
focus.en: This period covers 10/24-10/26. Geo/military: the Houthis launched this conflict's largest multi-site wave yet on 10/24-25, claiming simultaneous strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, Dammam's King Fahd International Airport, Najran Airport, Khamis Mushait air base, plus Aramco's Yanbu facility, the Rabigh refinery, and the East-West Pipeline; Yemen's Saudi-backed government separately alleged three ballistic missiles fired at coast guard headquarters in Aden. The Saudi-led coalition confirmed intercepting only two ballistic missiles toward Yanbu and Taif, without directly confirming 'hits' at Riyadh, Dammam or the other named sites; Saudi authorities also alleged the Houthis targeted Mecca and Medina, which the Houthis specifically denied — the two sides' accounts don't reconcile on either scale or targets, and this must be stated plainly as contested information warfare, not a verified damage list. The Houthis frame this wave as retaliation for nearly 100 Saudi airstrikes on Houthi-held areas in the preceding 24 hours, pushing the conflict further from the 10/14 report's framework of 'Trump draws the line at Iran proper, pulls back from Yemen's internal conflict' — this round of fire stays within Saudi Arabia and Yemen proper, not Iran, but its scale now exceeds the baseline the 10/18 report established ('19 dead, 364 wounded, 3 airports'), adding at least a fourth airport and an air base — showing that baseline was never the conflict's ceiling, just a snapshot at the time. The 10/22 report's methodological judgment was that an announced airport reopening doesn't mean risk has cleared — track actual airline schedules instead, since a gap between the two always persists. This period's development pushes that one step further: Riyadh's airport was scheduled to resume flights today, 10/26, but the Houthi spokesperson explicitly stated after this wave that the airport 'remains a military target' — meaning the earlier gap wasn't just administrative/insurance-assessment lag, but reflected that the security premise underlying 'reopening' never actually held. The US State Department had already ordered non-emergency staff and families out of Saudi Arabia on 10/21, three days before this wave (spokesperson Tommy Pigott specified Saudi Arabia only, not Gulf-wide) — in hindsight, that evacuation order's timing looks precisely calibrated. Brent crude already hit a five-month high of $111.05 on 10/20; no reliable post-escalation pricing data was found, but the direction should compound on the existing geopolitical risk premium. Ukraine front: Russia's assault on energy infrastructure shows no cooldown — Zelensky reported overnight strikes on 10/25 hitting a thermal power plant and substations again, killing 4 and injuring 28; Ukrainian officials tallied roughly 1,600 glide bombs, 48 missiles, and nearly 2,300 attack drones over the past week, the first time this front's attrition intensity has been quantified at a weekly scale — a baseline for future comparison that also reconfirms the 10/18 report's judgment that political-calendar convergence ahead of the US midterms does not cool Russia's battlefield tempo in lockstep. Cyber: BeyondTrust and Mandiant/GTIG jointly disclosed CVE-2026-102764 on 10/15 — a CVSS 4.0 9.3 zero-day in BeyondTrust Remote Support exploited since 8/29 by the China-nexus espionage cluster ARMORY CASTLE (previously tracked under the unattributed designation UNC5221; CrowdStrike calls it WARP PANDA), undetected by BeyondTrust itself until 9/28 — nearly seven weeks of dwell time. This site hadn't previously logged this incident; it's being caught up here because it directly bears on the border-device/remote-access supply-chain theme tracked here, and the attacker's deliberate deletion of system and application logs is worth recording. Separately, PHP2Shell's (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) exposure scale now has a sharper estimate: CybelAngel counted 2.24 million internet-exposed PHP hosts worldwide, 59% running version lines that will never receive a fix; CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz publicly warned on 10/23 this would trigger a breach wave, but as of this check, no confirmed mass-compromise incident has surfaced — exposure scale and actual breaches must be kept analytically separate. This period's nexus item reads the Houthi wave together with the 10/19 weekly's and 10/20 report's 'interceptor allocation queue: US first, Gulf second, Taiwan third' judgment — Saudi Arabia's own interceptor stockpile was already thin enough to prompt appeals to France, the UK, Pakistan and Egypt (some already rebuffed by the UK, Pakistan and Turkey), and this high-intensity multi-site wave is effectively a live-fire stress test on that already-strained queue, while Lockheed's own disclosed capacity ramp doesn't reach 2,000 units/year until end of 2030 — three facts from three different domains (real-time battlefield consumption, industrial capacity curve, geopolitical allocation priority) now share a checkable timestamp against each other.

title.zh: 胡塞10/24-25對沙烏地發動本輪最大規模多點攻勢——三座機場加一座空軍基地加兩處油源同時被點名，10/22報告『機場重開只是時間差』的判斷要升級成『重開前提本身不成立』
title.en: Houthis launch this round's largest multi-site wave against Saudi Arabia on 10/24-25 — three airports, an air base and two oil sites named at once, upgrading the 10/22 report's 'reopening is just a timing lag' call to 'the reopening's premise never held'

summary.zh: 胡塞武裝10/24-25聲稱對沙烏地阿拉伯發動多波攻勢，點名目標包括利雅德國王哈立德國際機場、達曼國王法赫德國際機場、納季蘭機場、海米斯穆塞特空軍基地，以及延布阿美石油設施、拉比格煉油廠與東西輸油管；葉門沙烏地支持的政府另指控胡塞對亞丁海巡總部發射3枚彈道飛彈。沙烏地聯軍官方僅證實攔截2枚分別飛向延布與塔伊夫的彈道飛彈，並通報有飛彈殘骸落在延布等地附近，但對利雅德、達曼、納季蘭等地『遭命中』的說法未正面證實或否認；沙方同時指控胡塞瞄準伊斯蘭教兩大聖城麥加與麥地那，胡塞發言人則單獨否認這項指控——雙方對攻擊規模與目標清單各執一詞，無法調和，必須明講這是尚未獨立核實的雙方主張，不是已確認的戰損清單。胡塞方面將這輪攻勢定調為對沙方前24小時內近百次空襲的回擊。往前看，較小規模的攻擊已有跡可循：10/22, 一架攻擊已造成達曼國王法赫德機場1死8傷。另外，美國國務院已於10/21(即本輪攻勢前3天)下令非緊急人員與眷屬撤離沙烏地阿拉伯——發言人Tommy Pigott當時特別澄清此令僅限沙國、並非外電報導的『全波灣撤離』，事後回看這個範圍判斷與時點相當精準。利雅德機場原訂10/26(今日)重新開放航班，但胡塞發言人在攻勢後已明確表示該機場『依然是軍事目標』。
summary.en: The Houthis claimed multiple waves of attacks against Saudi Arabia on 10/24-25, naming targets including Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, Dammam's King Fahd International Airport, Najran Airport, Khamis Mushait air base, and Aramco's Yanbu facility, the Rabigh refinery, and the East-West Pipeline; Yemen's Saudi-backed government separately alleged three ballistic missiles were fired at Aden's coast guard headquarters. The Saudi-led coalition officially confirmed only the interception of two ballistic missiles headed toward Yanbu and Taif, and reported missile debris falling near Yanbu and other sites, but neither confirmed nor denied claims of 'hits' at Riyadh, Dammam or Najran. Saudi authorities also alleged the Houthis targeted the two holiest cities in Islam, Mecca and Medina, which the Houthi spokesperson specifically denied — the two sides' claims on both scale and target list don't reconcile and must be stated plainly as unverified, competing assertions rather than a confirmed damage list. The Houthis frame this wave as retaliation for nearly 100 Saudi airstrikes on Houthi areas in the preceding 24 hours. Smaller-scale precursors were already visible: on 10/22, an attack reportedly killed 1 and injured 8 at Dammam's King Fahd airport. Separately, the US State Department had already ordered non-emergency staff and families out of Saudi Arabia on 10/21 — three days before this wave — with spokesperson Tommy Pigott specifically clarifying the order covered Saudi Arabia only, not the 'Gulf-wide evacuation' some wire reports implied; in hindsight, both the scope call and the timing look precisely calibrated. Riyadh's airport was scheduled to resume flights today, 10/26, but the Houthi spokesperson has already stated after this wave that the airport 'remains a military target.'

implication.zh: 10/22報告建立的方法論判斷是『機場宣布重開不代表風險解除，法律重開與航空公司實際排班是兩個獨立時鐘，後者永遠落後』——這次的新進展，把這個判斷從『行政/保險評估的滯後』往前推了一步：胡塞發言人在10/26重開前夕明確重申機場『仍是軍事目標』，意味著先前航空公司之所以不敢按官方時間表復飛，不是單純保守，而是準確判斷了安全前提根本沒有真正成立。對你評估這類『基礎設施宣布恢復』的新聞時，這給出一個更銳利的提問方式：不要只問『實際排班跟官方宣布差多久』，要問『攻擊方本身是否公開承認這個目標仍在清單上』——後者是比任何二手排班報導都更直接的訊號源。另外，10/18報告建立的『19死364傷、3座機場』基準線，這次被新增的第4座機場(納季蘭)與1座空軍基地(海米斯穆塞特)證明從來不是這場衝突的天花板，只是當時一個時間點的快照；對你跟決策者對話的操作意義是，任何『官方首次彙總戰果』的數字，都應該被當成下限而非上限來使用，尤其當衝突雙方都還有升級誘因(胡塞要報復近期沙方空襲、沙方要維持威懾)時。
implication.en: The 10/22 report's methodological judgment was that an announced airport reopening doesn't mean risk has cleared — legal reopening and actual airline scheduling run on two separate clocks, and the latter always lags. This period's development pushes that one step further, from 'administrative/insurance-assessment lag' to something sharper: the Houthi spokesperson's explicit restatement, on the eve of the planned 10/26 reopening, that the airport 'remains a military target' means airlines weren't just being conservative in ignoring the official timetable — they were accurately reading that the underlying security premise never actually held. For evaluating this class of 'infrastructure declared restored' news going forward, this gives a sharper question to ask: don't just ask how far actual scheduling lags the official announcement — ask whether the attacking side itself has publicly confirmed the target is still on its list, which is a more direct signal than any secondhand scheduling report. Separately, the 10/18 report's baseline of '19 dead, 364 wounded, 3 airports' is now shown, by the addition of a fourth airport (Najran) and an air base (Khamis Mushait), to never have been this conflict's ceiling — just a snapshot at one point in time. The operational takeaway for conversations with decision-makers: any 'first official tally' figure in an ongoing conflict should be treated as a floor, not a ceiling, especially while both sides retain incentives to escalate further (the Houthis to retaliate for recent Saudi strikes, the Saudis to maintain deterrence).

counterpoint.zh: 沙烏地聯軍官方只證實在延布與塔伊夫方向攔截2枚彈道飛彈，對利雅德、達曼、納季蘭等地的『命中』說法既未證實也未正面否認；沙方指控胡塞瞄準麥加、麥地那這項主張更被胡塞單獨否認。換句話說，這次攻勢的實際命中範圍與戰損規模，目前完全建立在雙方互不相讓的主張之上，沒有獨立第三方(如衛星影像分析機構或國際媒體現場查證)的交叉確認，本條目的confidence因此定為likely而非confirmed，實際戰果應等待後續查核。
counterpoint.en: The Saudi-led coalition officially confirmed intercepting only two ballistic missiles toward Yanbu and Taif, neither confirming nor denying claims of 'hits' at Riyadh, Dammam, or Najran; the Saudi allegation that the Houthis targeted Mecca and Medina is itself specifically denied by the Houthis. In other words, the actual extent of impact and damage from this wave currently rests entirely on mutually contradictory claims from the two combatants, with no independent third-party cross-confirmation (such as satellite-imagery analysis or on-the-ground media verification) yet available — which is why this item is scored likely rather than confirmed, and the actual scope of damage should be treated as pending further verification.

items.source: France24、Al Jazeera、ABC News、Business Standard、Malay Mail（胡塞方與沙烏地聯軍雙方聲明互不一致，尚無獨立第三方核實）

title.zh: 烏克蘭過去一週首度被量化：約1,600枚滑翔炸彈、48枚飛彈、近2,300架攻擊無人機，10/25熱電廠再遭夜襲——10/18報告『俄軍戰場烈度與美國期中選舉政治日曆脫鉤』的判斷持續成立
title.en: Ukraine's past week gets quantified for the first time — ~1,600 glide bombs, 48 missiles, nearly 2,300 attack drones — as a thermal plant is hit again overnight on 10/25, reconfirming the 10/18 report's 'Russian battlefield tempo is decoupled from the US midterm political calendar' judgment

summary.zh: 澤倫斯基10/25通報，俄軍夜間再度打擊烏克蘭能源設施，包括至少一座熱電廠與多個變電站，造成4死28傷；烏克蘭官方同時彙整過去一週(約10/18-10/25)的攻勢規模數據：俄軍共發射約1,600枚滑翔炸彈、48枚飛彈、近2,300架攻擊無人機，這是本站首次看到這條戰線的攻勢烈度被量化到週級的綜合數字，而非單一事件的單日統計。這延續10/19-10/22報告記錄的電網危機(12州跳電、全境工業限電排程)沒有出現任何降溫跡象，10/25的打擊顯示整個10月下旬，俄方對能源基礎設施的攻擊節奏維持在高檔，沒有因為任何外部政治行事曆(美國期中選舉11/3、或先前川普單方宣布又被自家盟友拆穿的『能源停火』)而放緩。
summary.en: Zelensky reported on 10/25 that Russia struck Ukraine's energy infrastructure again overnight, hitting at least one thermal power plant and multiple substations, killing 4 and injuring 28; Ukrainian officials simultaneously tallied the past week's (roughly 10/18-10/25) strike volume: about 1,600 glide bombs, 48 missiles, and nearly 2,300 attack drones fired by Russian forces — the first time this site has seen this front's strike intensity quantified as a weekly aggregate rather than single-event daily figures. This extends the grid crisis recorded in the 10/19-10/22 reports (12 regions losing power, nationwide industrial power-limiting schedules) with no sign of cooldown; the 10/25 strike shows Russia's energy-infrastructure attack tempo held at a high level through late October, unaffected by any external political calendar — neither the 11/3 US midterms nor the earlier unilaterally announced 'energy ceasefire' that Trump's own ally disproved within 24 hours.

implication.zh: 10/18報告的nexus判斷是『11/3期中選舉前，美國行政團隊在三個議題上應預期象徵性、低承諾成本的動作，但這不代表俄烏戰場本身的物理烈度會收斂』——這次的週級彙整數字給了這個判斷一個可以持續比對的量化基準：約1,600枚滑翔炸彈、48枚飛彈、近2,300架攻擊無人機，這組數字本身不只是『烈度沒有降低』的定性描述，而是一個往後每期都可以拿來做同比的具體基線。對你做威脅獵捕與態勢判斷的操作意義：如果接下來幾期這個週級數字出現明顯下滑(例如腰斬)，才真正代表某種外部壓力(例如嚴冬將至彈藥庫存見底、或是外交斡旋取得實質進展)在起作用；如果數字持續持平或走高，則『期中選舉後會緩和』這類基於美國政治日曆的預期，在這條戰線上應該被直接排除，不必每期重新驗證一次。
implication.en: The 10/18 report's nexus judgment was that ahead of the 11/3 US midterms, the US administration should be expected to take symbolic, low-commitment actions on three specific issues — but that this would not translate into the Russia-Ukraine battlefield itself cooling down. This period's weekly aggregate gives that judgment a concrete, repeatable baseline to track: roughly 1,600 glide bombs, 48 missiles, and nearly 2,300 attack drones. That figure isn't just a qualitative 'intensity hasn't dropped' statement — it's a specific number that can be compared period-over-period going forward. Operationally, for threat assessment and situational judgment: if this weekly figure shows a clear drop (say, halving) in coming periods, that would be the real signal that some external pressure (winter munitions-stock depletion, or genuine diplomatic progress) is taking hold; if the number holds steady or rises, any expectation that things 'ease after the midterms' based on the US political calendar should be ruled out for this front outright, without needing to re-verify it every period.

items.source: Zelensky官方聲明（經Euronews轉述）、烏克蘭官方週度彙整數據

title.zh: BeyondTrust與Mandiant/GTIG 10/15聯合揭露：中國關聯ARMORY CASTLE(原UNC5221)用CVSS 9.3零時差打穿Remote Support，潛伏近七週、刻意清除系統日誌——本站先前未收錄，這次回補
title.en: BeyondTrust and Mandiant/GTIG jointly disclose on 10/15: China-nexus ARMORY CASTLE (formerly UNC5221) breaches Remote Support via a CVSS-9.3 zero-day, dwells nearly seven weeks, deliberately wipes system logs — not previously logged by this site, caught up here

summary.zh: BeyondTrust與Google威脅情報小組(GTIG)/Mandiant於10/15聯合揭露CVE-2026-102764，一個CVSS v4.0評分9.3的BeyondTrust Remote Support零時差漏洞，影響版本涵蓋到26.2.3。BeyondTrust以中高信心度評估此次入侵為中國關聯間諜集群所為，Mandiant將其正式命名為ARMORY CASTLE(先前以未歸類編號UNC5221追蹤)，CrowdStrike則另以WARP PANDA標示同一群集。攻擊者自8/29起開始利用，鎖定至少一個BeyondTrust代管執行個體與一個自建代管執行個體，直到9/28——即在業界因另一廠商邊界設備遭公開攻擊而提高警覺後——BeyondTrust才自行發現這起入侵，潛伏期近七週。入侵後行為包括：取得主機層級控制權、存取並列舉設備所儲存或代理的所有憑證、部署名為SAWFLY的網頁後門程式以維持持續性、使用新型SOCKS5通道工具BARECLAW掩護後續流量、並刪除系統、網頁伺服器與應用程式層級的日誌以妨礙鑑識分析，另從標準服務帳號提權至完整管理員權限。資安巡測機構Shadowserver追蹤到全球逾1,400個BeyondTrust Remote Support執行個體仍曝險於公開網路。BeyondTrust已於10/8前後發布修補，並建議自建代管客戶從乾淨映像重建受駭設備，而非僅做原地清理，因為攻擊者建立的主機層級持久性能撐過重開機與組態重置。
summary.en: BeyondTrust and Google's Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG)/Mandiant jointly disclosed CVE-2026-102764 on 10/15, a CVSS v4.0 9.3 zero-day in BeyondTrust Remote Support affecting versions up to 26.2.3. BeyondTrust assessed with moderate-to-high confidence that the intrusion was carried out by a China-nexus espionage cluster, which Mandiant formally designated ARMORY CASTLE (previously tracked under the unattributed designation UNC5221); CrowdStrike separately tracks the same cluster as WARP PANDA. The attacker began exploiting the flaw on 8/29, targeting at least one BeyondTrust-hosted instance and one self-hosted instance, and BeyondTrust itself only discovered the intrusion on 9/28 — after the industry's guard went up following a public attack on another vendor's edge appliances — meaning nearly seven weeks of dwell time. Post-compromise behavior included: gaining host-level control, accessing and enumerating every credential the appliance stored or brokered, deploying a webshell named SAWFLY for persistence, using a new SOCKS5 tunneling tool called BARECLAW to mask follow-on traffic, deleting system, web-server, and application-level logs to hinder forensic analysis, and escalating from a standard service account to full administrative privileges. Security-scanning organization Shadowserver tracked over 1,400 BeyondTrust Remote Support instances still exposed on the public internet. BeyondTrust shipped a patch around 10/8 and advised self-hosted customers to rebuild compromised devices from a clean image rather than clean them in place, since the attacker's host-level persistence can survive reboots and configuration resets.

implication.zh: 這起事件本站先前未收錄，之所以這次回補，是因為它與本站自9/16報告起持續追蹤的邊界設備/遠端存取供應鏈風險主題直接相關，而且提供了一個比先前案例更完整的『潛伏期有多長』樣本：近七週的時間裡，攻擊者不只取得存取權，還完整走完『提權、存取憑證庫、建立持久性、清除證據』這一整套標準作業流程，而受害組織本身的偵測能力完全沒有觸發——直到另一起無關廠商的公開事件才間接促成這起入侵被回頭發現。對你做威脅獵捕與provenance graph建模的操作意義：『因為另一個廠商的事件而回頭檢查自己的環境』這個發現路徑本身值得被當成一種制度化流程，而不是僥倖——當產業對某一類資產(這裡是遠端支援/存取應用程式)的集體警覺度被提高時，應該視為一次免費的、觸發重新稽核既有同類資產的機會窗口。另外，攻擊者刪除日誌而非偽造日誌的做法，與本站9/16報告收錄的UTA0576(Ivanti案例，『連日誌都竄改不留惡意程式樣本』)屬於同一類反鑑識手法家族，但這次更進一步直接清除而非竄改——代表攻擊者評估『被發現有入侵痕跡』與『被完整重建攻擊鏈』之間，寧可冒前者的風險也要阻斷後者，這個取捨本身透露出其對歸因與情報蒐集延續性的重視程度，高於單純掩蓋存在。
implication.en: This site hadn't previously logged this incident; it's being caught up here because it directly bears on the border-device/remote-access supply-chain risk theme tracked since the 9/16 report, and because it offers a more complete sample than prior cases of just how long dwell time can run: over nearly seven weeks, the attacker didn't just gain access — it completed a full standard playbook of privilege escalation, credential-store access, persistence establishment, and evidence removal, with the victim organization's own detection capability never triggering at all until an unrelated vendor's public incident indirectly prompted the retrospective discovery. For threat-hunting and provenance-graph modeling, the operational point is this: 'checking your own environment because of another vendor's incident' should be treated as an institutionalized process, not a stroke of luck — when industry-wide vigilance rises for one asset class (here, remote-support/access applications), that moment should be used as a free trigger window to re-audit your own instances of the same class. Separately, the attacker's choice to delete logs rather than tamper with them belongs to the same anti-forensics family as UTA0576 (the Ivanti case logged in the 9/16 report, which 'tampered with logs and left no malware sample'), but goes a step further by outright deleting rather than altering — suggesting the attacker judged that between 'being discovered to have intruded' and 'having the full attack chain reconstructed,' it would rather risk the former to block the latter. That tradeoff itself signals the actor values attribution avoidance and continuity of intelligence collection more than simply hiding its presence.

counterpoint.zh: 本條目的資訊全數來自BeyondTrust官方部落格與Mandiant/GTIG公開報告，經CSOonline、BleepingComputer、Cloud Security Alliance、The Record等媒體轉述，本站這次因網路連線問題未能直接讀取BeyondTrust與Mandiant的原始公告全文進行一次來源驗證，因此confidence定為likely而非confirmed；另外，各媒體對修補發布的確切日期(10/8或10/9)與BeyondTrust內部發現時間(9/27或9/28)的轉述本身就有一天左右的落差，顯示即使是轉述同一份官方公告，媒體之間的細節也未必完全一致。
counterpoint.en: All information in this item comes from BeyondTrust's official blog and Mandiant/GTIG's public report, relayed through CSOonline, BleepingComputer, Cloud Security Alliance, and The Record; this site was unable to directly read the original BeyondTrust and Mandiant announcements in full to perform its own source verification due to a connectivity issue, which is why confidence is scored likely rather than confirmed. Separately, outlets' reporting of the exact patch-release date (10/8 or 10/9) and BeyondTrust's internal discovery date (9/27 or 9/28) differs by about a day, showing that even secondhand reporting of the same official announcement doesn't always agree on every detail.

items.source: BeyondTrust官方公告、Mandiant/GTIG報告（經CSOonline、BleepingComputer、Cloud Security Alliance、The Record轉述）

title.zh: PHP2Shell曝險規模精算出爐：全球224萬台公開PHP主機、59%已不再有修補——CrowdStrike執行長10/23公開示警入侵潮將至，但截至查核仍無證實的大規模淪陷案例
title.en: PHP2Shell's exposure gets a precise count — 2.24 million internet-facing PHP hosts worldwide, 59% beyond patch support — as CrowdStrike's CEO publicly warns on 10/23 of a coming breach wave, though no confirmed mass compromise has surfaced yet

summary.zh: 本站10/24報告已收錄PHP2Shell(CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619)這兩個CVSS 9.2未經驗證RCE漏洞的基本事實；這次的新進展是曝險規模有了更精確的量化。資安研究機構CybelAngel清點全球公開曝露在網路上的PHP主機共224萬台，其中59%運行在已停止提供安全修補的版本線上，意味著這些主機即使想修補也沒有官方修補可用，只能透過升級到仍受支援的版本線才能徹底解決。CrowdStrike執行長George Kurtz 10/23公開發言，直指這起漏洞影響全球近七成網站使用的程式語言，預期將引發一波入侵潮。但截至本次查核(10/26)，多方資安廠商觀測到的仍只是掃描與攻擊嘗試，尚未看到任何一起被證實的大規模資料外洩或淪陷案例被公開點名。荷蘭政府機構與GrapheneOS開發團隊已基於預防性考量，暫時將部分系統下線。
summary.en: This site's 10/24 report already logged the basic facts of PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), two CVSS-9.2 unauthenticated RCE flaws. What's new this period is a sharper quantification of exposure scale: security research firm CybelAngel counted 2.24 million internet-exposed PHP hosts worldwide, 59% of which run version lines that no longer receive security patches — meaning these hosts have no official fix available even if their operators want one, and can only resolve the issue by upgrading to a still-supported version line. CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz publicly stated on 10/23 that the flaw affects the programming language behind nearly 70% of the world's websites and predicted it would trigger a breach wave. But as of this check (10/26), multiple security vendors have observed only scanning and exploitation attempts — no confirmed mass data-exfiltration or compromise incident has been publicly named yet. The Dutch government and the GrapheneOS development team have each taken some systems offline as a precaution.

implication.zh: 10/24報告的implication已經點出，這個漏洞真正該追蹤的指標不是『是否已被證實大規模利用』，而是『會不會被打包進自動化掃描工具的常態掃描清單』；這次CybelAngel給出的224萬台/59%不可修補這組數字，等於把這個追蹤指標的『基準母體規模』量化出來了——59%這個比例特別值得記住，因為它代表即使全球資安社群的修補宣導完全成功、所有『還能修補』的站台都在本週內完成升級，仍然會剩下超過一半的曝險主機處於『永久無修補可用、只能靠升級版本線或下線』的狀態，這是一個結構性問題，不是時間問題。對你評估供應鏈/第三方風險時的操作意義：如果你在盤點自己環境或客戶環境中的PHP資產，『目前跑的是哪一條版本線』這個問題，現在有了明確的量化後果——落在59%那個群組裡的主機，風險視窗事實上是無限期的。CrowdStrike執行長的公開示警本身是一個值得記錄的『業界預期訊號』，但你在跟決策者轉述時應該明確區分：這是一位資安廠商執行長基於曝險規模做出的預測，不是已發生的事實，下一期查核應該鎖定的是，這波預期中的入侵潮是否真的在未來1-2週內浮現可被點名的真實案例。
implication.en: The 10/24 report's implication already flagged that the real metric worth tracking for this flaw isn't whether mass exploitation has been confirmed, but whether it gets folded into automated scanners' standard target lists. CybelAngel's 2.24-million/59%-unpatchable figures this period quantify the base population size for that tracking metric — the 59% figure is especially worth remembering, because it means that even if the global security community's patch-awareness campaign were to succeed completely and every host capable of patching updated within the week, more than half of all exposed hosts would still be stuck in a state of permanently no fix available, resolvable only by upgrading the version line or taking the host offline. That's a structural problem, not a time problem. Operationally, for assessing supply-chain/third-party risk: if you're inventorying PHP assets in your own or a client's environment, 'which version line is currently running' now carries a clearly quantified consequence — hosts falling into that 59% group face an effectively indefinite risk window. CrowdStrike's CEO publicly warning about this is itself worth logging as an industry-expectation signal, but when relaying this to decision-makers you should clearly distinguish: this is a security vendor CEO's prediction based on exposure scale, not something that has happened yet. The next check should specifically look for whether this anticipated breach wave actually produces nameable real-world cases within the next 1-2 weeks.

items.source: CybelAngel研究部落格、CrowdStrike執行長George Kurtz公開發言（經24/7 Wall St.轉述）

title.zh: 胡塞這波攻勢，剛好是對『攔截彈分配隊伍：美軍優先、波灣次之、台灣第三』判斷的一次實彈壓力測試——而洛馬自己的產能時間表要到2030年底才到得了2,000枚年產能
title.en: The Houthis' latest wave is a live-fire stress test on the 'interceptor allocation queue: US first, Gulf second, Taiwan third' judgment — while Lockheed's own disclosed capacity timeline doesn't reach 2,000 units/year until end of 2030

summary.zh: 本期nexus把三個分屬不同領域、但這次有了同一個可比時間點的事實放在一起讀。第一，即時戰場消耗端：胡塞10/24-25對沙烏地發動本輪最大規模多點攻勢，沙烏地聯軍官方證實至少攔截2枚彈道飛彈，意味著無論實際命中範圍如何，沙方的防空/飛彈防禦系統在這幾天內確實被要求連續運作、消耗攔截彈庫存。第二，地緣分配順位端：10/19週報與10/20報告已建立的判斷是，沙烏地自身的攔截彈庫存早已因長期消耗而吃緊，不得不把求援對象從波灣盟友擴大到法國、英國、巴基斯坦、埃及，而其中英國、巴基斯坦、土耳其已對特定請求表示回絕或保留；這個隊伍的排序是美軍自身庫存優先、波灣盟友次之，台灣相關的140億美元軍售案則被10/19週報定性為卡在認證瓶頸而非資金瓶頸，實質上排在更後面。第三，產業產能曲線端：洛克希德馬丁自己在Q2、Q3財報揭露的7年期PAC-3框架協議，目標是把年產能從約600枚拉高到2,000枚，但10/19週報與10/22報告查核後的判斷是，這個擴產時間表要到2030年底才能到位，是認證進度(尤其是過氯酸銨單一供應商AMPAC第二條產線的認證)的函數，不是砸錢就能加速的函數。這三個事實原本分屬『正在發生的戰場消耗』『誰先拿到貨的地緣排序』『還要多久才有貨的產業時程』三條不同的敘事線，這次因為胡塞攻勢剛好發生在洛馬揭露框架協議細節之後不到一週，而有了可以互相校驗的時間戳記。
summary.en: This period's nexus item reads together three facts from three different domains that now share a comparable timestamp. First, real-time battlefield consumption: the Houthis launched this round's largest multi-site wave against Saudi Arabia on 10/24-25, with the Saudi-led coalition officially confirming at least two ballistic-missile intercepts — meaning that regardless of the actual scope of impact, Saudi air-defense/missile-defense systems were required to operate continuously over these days, drawing down interceptor stockpiles. Second, geopolitical allocation priority: the 10/19 weekly and 10/20 report already established that Saudi Arabia's own interceptor stockpile was already strained from prolonged consumption, forcing it to widen its appeals beyond Gulf allies to France, the UK, Pakistan, and Egypt — with the UK, Pakistan, and Turkey already declining or hedging on specific requests. This queue's order places US domestic stockpiles first, Gulf allies second, while Taiwan's related $14 billion arms package was characterized by the 10/19 weekly as stuck on a certification bottleneck rather than a funding one — effectively placing it further back still. Third, the industrial capacity curve: Lockheed Martin's own Q2 and Q3 earnings disclosures reveal a seven-year PAC-3 framework agreement aiming to raise annual capacity from roughly 600 to 2,000 units, but the 10/19 weekly's and 10/22 report's checked judgment is that this capacity ramp doesn't land until end of 2030, being a function of certification progress (particularly sole-source supplier AMPAC's second ammonium-perchlorate line certification) rather than something money alone can accelerate. These three facts normally belong to three separate narrative threads — ongoing battlefield consumption, who-gets-supplied-first geopolitical ordering, and how-long-until-supply industrial timelines — but because the Houthi wave happened to land less than a week after Lockheed disclosed its framework-agreement details, they now carry a timestamp that lets them be checked against each other.

implication.zh: 對你做威脅獵捕、provenance graph建模與國防股操作的綜合操作意義是：這三條線裡，『即時戰場消耗』是唯一一個此刻就在發生、且速度最快的變數，而『地緣分配順位』與『產業產能曲線』都是以月甚至年為單位移動的慢變數——這個速度落差本身就是你該帶進決策者對話的核心訊息。具體來說，當沙烏地這類已經在隊伍前段的國家都要向外求援、且部分盟友已回絕部分請求時，這代表隊伍前段的供給本身也已經出現縫隙，不是單純『排隊等久一點』的問題；對台灣這類被10/19週報定位在隊伍末端的案例而言，這意味著即使140億美元軍售案的認證瓶頸未來某天解除，實際交付能排到的產能窗口，很可能已經被沙烏地這類前段國家的額外消耗進一步往後擠壓。對你跟決策者對話時最有用的一句話是：『攔截彈短缺不是因為沒人要生產，是因為生產曲線的形狀(認證驅動、無法用資金拉直)決定了它永遠追不上任何一次意外的戰場消耗高峰』——下一個查核點是，法、英、巴基斯坦、埃及之中是否有任何一方在未來1-2個月內證實真的交付攔截彈給沙烏地，這會是檢驗『隊伍排序』能否真正鬆動的第一手證據。
implication.en: The combined operational point for threat hunting, provenance-graph modeling, and defense-stock positioning is this: of these three threads, real-time battlefield consumption is the only variable happening right now, moving at the fastest speed, while geopolitical allocation priority and the industrial capacity curve are both slow variables moving on a scale of months to years — that speed gap is itself the core message worth bringing into a conversation with decision-makers. Concretely, when a country as far up the queue as Saudi Arabia already needs to appeal outward, with some allies already declining specific requests, that signals a gap has already opened even in the front of the queue's supply — this isn't simply a matter of waiting longer in line. For a case like Taiwan, positioned at the back of that queue per the 10/19 weekly, this means that even once the $14 billion package's certification bottleneck eventually clears, the actual delivery-capacity window it can claim has likely already been further squeezed by front-of-queue countries' extra consumption, such as Saudi Arabia's here. The most useful sentence for a decision-maker conversation: interceptor shortages aren't because no one wants to produce them — they're because the shape of the production curve (certification-driven, not something money can straighten out) can never catch up to any unexpected spike in battlefield consumption. The next checkpoint: whether any of France, the UK, Pakistan, or Egypt confirms an actual interceptor delivery to Saudi Arabia within the next 1-2 months — that would be the first hard evidence of whether the queue's ordering can genuinely loosen.

items.source: 綜合本站10/19週報、10/20報告、10/22報告既有判斷，與France24、Business Standard對胡塞10/24-25攻勢之報導
